params.name: t1
params.description: Start of the date range in which returned events should have availability. Defaults to today.

params.name: t2
params.description: End of the date range in which returned events should have availability. Defaults to 14 days from now.

params.name: category
params.description: Category or categories to restrict query to.

params.name: city
params.description: City or cities to restrict query to.

params.name: state
params.description: State or states to restrict query to.

params.name: region
params.description: Region or regions to restrict the query to.

params.name: country
params.description: Countries to restrict query to.

params.name: country_code
params.description: Two-letter ISO country codes to restrict query to.

params.name: performer
params.description: Performers to restrict query to.

params.name: venue
params.description: Venues to restrict query to.

params.description: Event types to restrict the query to.

params.name: max_price

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency to both display event prices and to restrict the min/max price query to.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to perform a search of events with.

params.name: range
params.description: Maximum distance from the requested city or cities, in km.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination; see also `limit` and the `X-Total-Count` response header.

params.description: Number of results to return for pagination; see also `skip` and the `X-Total-Count` response header.

params.name: partial_match
params.description: Perform partial/substring text matching, includes fuzzy search (max 1 character change)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort order to use.If not specified, the default sort order is textual relevance if applicable, else geographical distance if applicable, else an arbitrary stable order.

params.description: Profile name

params.name: hostname
params.description: Associated hostname

items.docs:
Retrieves events from the Tickitto inventory.

The search endpoint is typically the first endpoint called to initiate an interaction with the Tickitto API and retrieves events within the date ranges specified.

The Tickitto inventory is availability aware. Therefore, at the time of performing a search query, all events returned will have availability instances for the date range specified.

If an event does not have any availability within the specified search date, it will not be returned in se
